parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp path — a canonical sample-app location. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record carries is_sample_app=true or resides under Examples/ must be treated as a sample-app-mirror and no refactoring action should be taken. Lifting the production DebugPanel definition into shared code to unify it with the sample-app copy would couple production semantics to demonstration code, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
